technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average technique for EU. Assumption: heating 100% with natural gas. Furnaces of about 10 MW are approxi-mated by furnace "> 100 kW"

# Included processes
Includes the process steps scarfing, grinding heating, descaling, rolling and finishing. Semiclosed water circuit with water treatment plant is also included. Does not include the material being rolled
